subject.title: [Feature]: Add guarded keyboard shortcuts for session/agent switching in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept guarded positional/cyclic session or agent switching shortcuts, and if so which key bindings and session ordering should be the contract?
rationale: The feature is useful but changes global dashboard keyboard behavior and active session context, so automation should not choose browser-conflicting bindings or ordering semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve A Narrow Shortcut Contract
options.body: Define the exact bindings and order, then implement them in the shared guarded dashboard shortcut path with focused UI tests.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Session Workspace
options.body: Keep this request linked to the broader sessions workspace direction and avoid adding standalone shortcuts until that surface is designed.

options.title: Decline Global Session Shortcuts
options.body: Leave session switching in the picker/sidebar/command palette to avoid browser shortcut conflicts and accidental context changes.

recommendation.title: Approve A Narrow Shortcut Contract
recommendation.body: Define the exact bindings and order, then implement them in the shared guarded dashboard shortcut path with focused UI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent history on sidebar session shortcuts and chat session controls, making them the best routing owner for the binding/order decision.
